meta.description: Auditable licensing manifest for legally reusable Arabic supplemental content in BuddyAR. This JSON file is the single source of truth. The .csv mirror is generated from it (npm run licenses:csv). Never hand-edit the CSV.
meta.generated_note: This manifest was seeded in a build environment that could NOT open individual asset pages (Wikimedia, StoryWeaver, and similar returned HTTP 403 through the sandbox proxy). Per the core rule, no asset may be marked 'approved-for-pilot' until a human opens its individual asset page and records the exact per-item license. All seeded pilot assets are therefore 'candidate' or 'needs-human-review'.

hard_rules: Never treat a platform as cleared when licenses vary by item. Verify each asset's individual page.
'Free to access' or 'free to study' is NOT a reuse license.
Third-party textbook scans (Bayna Yadayk, Madinah, Al-Kitaab, Gateway, Mastering Arabic, Internet Archive / Scribd / blog reposts) are NOT cleared for redistribution or remixing inside BuddyAR.
Ambiguous or missing license => status must be 'needs-human-review'; never auto-approve.
CC-BY-SA content requires share_alike=true and separation from proprietary BuddyAR content.

assets.notes: POOL with MIXED per-file licenses. Do NOT treat the category as one license. Verify each file page; reject NC/ND; preserve public-domain rationale where claimed; do not assume old-looking = public domain.
